## Solarum 0.11.0 – a cleaner sound, a smoother room, and Luna plays with more air 🪐

> Solarum is still very much under development. Try it, break it, tell us what you think – criticism, ideas and help are very welcome: [open an issue](https://github.com/tj537/solarum/issues).

### A cleaner sound
- **A new master bus.** The old one pushed the whole mix through one saturator, so loud parts got muddy and harsh. Now the mix keeps its headroom and a look-ahead limiter catches the peaks – the beat stays punchy without distorting. It's a little quieter than before; turn it up as usual.
- **A smoother reverb.** The room is new: a soft, even tail instead of a metallic ring, and the kick no longer goes into it, so the low end stays tight.
- **Echoes fade into the background.** Every repeat comes back a bit darker and thinner instead of piling up.
- **Details:** the 303 keeps its squelch, kick rolls don't click, the hats keep their air at the default DARK, and bass and synth notes start softly instead of with a click. Pads, chord stabs and supersaws are in stereo.

### Luna plays with more air
- **Fewer tracks at once.** Kick, clap, hat and bass are the core; of rim, open hat, ride and synth only two play at the same time (three in the big-room vibes). Every sound gets room to breathe.
- **Real riffs.** Luna's synth lines are short melodies that repeat – a few notes, a question and an answer – instead of lines that wander over two octaves. Chords change on the bar, not in the middle of it.
- **Plainer sounds first.** The proven sounds come up most; the odd ones (cowbell, zap, hoover …) are a spice now, not the rule.

### Fixes
- A new chapter in the auto mode no longer brings the synth in on top of everything else – it takes another extra's place.
- The GitHub link in the settings keeps clear of the scroll bar.

### Downloads

- **macOS 11+** (Apple Silicon & Intel): `Solarum-macos-universal.zip`
- **Windows 10/11:** `Solarum-windows-x64.zip`

Check them against `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

The Mac app is not notarized yet: on first launch, open *System Settings → Privacy & Security* and click *Open Anyway*. Windows SmartScreen may ask once: *More info → Run anyway*.
